# CEL Lint Integration Tests

# ============================================================
# Section 1: akb lint with CEL lint rules
# ============================================================

exec akb init cel-lint-kb
cd cel-lint-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

# Write fresh pages
stdin ../fresh-note.md
exec akb write notes/fresh.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/fresh.md'

stdin ../fresh-adr.md
exec akb write decisions/fresh-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/fresh-adr.md'

# Write stale pages
stdin ../stale-note.md
exec akb write notes/stale.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/stale.md'

stdin ../stale-adr.md
exec akb write decisions/stale-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/stale-adr.md'

# Run lint — should find stale pages via cel_lint
exec akb lint
stdout 'cel_lint'
stdout 'adr_stale'
stdout 'note_stale'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: JSON output includes rule_id
# ============================================================

exec akb lint --json
stdout '"cel_lint"'
stdout '"rule_id"'
stdout '"adr_stale"'
stdout '"note_stale"'
stdout '"severity"'
stdout '"warning"'

-- fresh-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Fresh Note
summary: A recently updated note
tags: [linttest]
created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
---
This note is fresh.

-- stale-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Stale Note
summary: An old note
tags: [linttest]
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---
This note is very stale.

-- fresh-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Fresh ADR
summary: A recently updated ADR
tags: [linttest]
status: accepted
deciders: team
created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Fresh ADR

## Context

Fresh context. The sweep checks how long ago a record was updated, so this decision keeps a recent updated date and is not reported as stale. See [[fresh]] for the note that shares the same window.

## Decision

Fresh decision. The decision is accepted, so the deprecated and proposed branches of the lint rules do not apply to it.

## Consequences

Fresh consequences. The sweep reports the stale page beside this one, which keeps the rule under test.

-- stale-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Stale ADR
summary: An old ADR
tags: [linttest]
status: accepted
deciders: team
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Stale ADR

## Context

Old context. The sweep checks how long ago a record was updated, so this decision keeps an old updated date and is reported as stale. See [[stale]] for the note that shares the same window.

## Decision

Old decision. The decision is accepted, so the deprecated and proposed branches of the lint rules do not apply to it.

## Consequences

Old consequences. The stale report names the rule and the page it fired on.
